contractName: CrazyGames SDK v3 WebGL Bridge Specification
description: Defines the external C# [DllImport("__Internal")] to JavaScript WebGL jslib bridge methods, callbacks, payloads, and mock responses for BroTel on CrazyGames.

methods.name: CrazyGames_Init
methods.description: Initializes window.CrazyGames.SDK asynchronously. Must be invoked at game boot.

methods.name: CrazyGames_RequestMidgameAd
methods.csharpSignature: void CrazyGames_RequestMidgameAd(string gameObjectName, string callbackSuccess, string callbackError)
methods.description: Requests a midgame interstitial ad. Mutes audio and pauses game during playback.

methods.name: CrazyGames_RequestRewardedAd
methods.csharpSignature: void CrazyGames_RequestRewardedAd(string gameObjectName, string callbackSuccess, string callbackError)
methods.description: Requests a rewarded video ad. Grants reward only on completed playback.

methods.name: CrazyGames_GameplayStart
methods.description: Signals that active gameplay has started or resumed.

methods.name: CrazyGames_GameplayStop
methods.description: Signals that active gameplay has paused or stopped (menu, shop, day end).

methods.name: CrazyGames_HappyTime
methods.description: Celebratory cheer trigger on floor unlock or major accomplishment.

methods.name: CrazyGames_HasAdblock
methods.description: Returns 1 if adblock is detected, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: CrazyGames_SaveData
methods.csharpSignature: void CrazyGames_SaveData(string key, string jsonData, string gameObjectName, string callbackSuccess, string callbackError)
methods.description: Persists game state JSON to CrazyGames Cloud Save.

methods.name: CrazyGames_LoadData
methods.csharpSignature: void CrazyGames_LoadData(string key, string gameObjectName, string callbackSuccess, string callbackError)
methods.description: Retrieves persisted game state JSON from CrazyGames Cloud Save.
